task.title: Audit and design Strength reconciliation semantics

result.summary: Completed the read-only authority, production-state, link/claim/matcher, canonical-command, and Native Evidence Review audit. Defined a fail-closed design: auto-confirm is an explicit deterministic predicate over hard facts, not a score threshold; ambiguity becomes one deterministic Evidence Review reconciliation record; Founder resolutions are durable, idempotent, strategically inert history; and no history signal may bypass family, temporal, competition, duplicate, or one-to-one guards. No application, policy, production relationship, or Apple state changed.
